jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer (MarTech Product Manager)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro.**

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**Requirements**

* Experience : 7.5+ years
* Strong experience as a Product Manager focused on MarTech, CRM, or email marketing platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Content Builder.
* Proven experience configuring, managing, or integrating OneTrust Preference Center for subscription management, consent capture, and privacy compliance workflows.
* Strong expertise in email campaign management, including campaign design, audience segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and automated customer journeys.
* Solid understanding of product management fundamentals, including Agile/Scrum methodologies, product roadmapping, backlog management, and writing PRDs and user stories.
* Experience in requirement gathering and translating business, marketing, and compliance needs into detailed functional and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating campaign and platform metrics such as open rates, click-through rates (CTR), email deliverability, and opt-in/opt-out trends.
* Proven stakeholder management experience, with the ability to collaborate across Marketing, Legal, Privacy, and Engineering teams.
* Good understanding of email deliverability, privacy regulations, and compliance standards, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, CASL, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels such as SEO/SEM, paid social, display advertising, and multi-channel campaign orchestration.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), and their integration with SFMC.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL and AMPscript for data extensions, audience queries, and dynamic content personalization.
* Exposure to other marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable.
* Understanding of consent management platforms, privacy technology solutions, REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware integrations.
* Good understanding of UX/UI principles for designing intuitive preference centers and email interaction journeys.
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications (Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Consultant) and/or OneTrust certifications would be an added advantage.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as BFSI, healthcare, or insurance is preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for MarTech platforms, with a focus on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and OneTrust Preference Center.
* Drive end-to-end product management activities, including product discovery, requirement gathering, prioritization, planning, and delivery.
* Define and manage product roadmaps, backlogs, epics, user stories, and product requirement documents (PRDs).
* Lead the development and optimization of Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities, leveraging Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Content Builder.
* Manage and enhance OneTrust Preference Center capabilities for subscription preferences, consent capture, opt-in/opt-out management, and privacy compliance.
* Drive email campaign management initiatives, ensuring effective segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and automated customer journeys.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Engineering teams to align product priorities with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business needs and compliance requirements into clear functional and technical specifications for development teams.
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, including open rates, CTR, deliverability, engagement, and subscription trends to drive product improvements.
* Ensure email marketing platforms comply with applicable data privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM, and CASL.
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce Marketing Cloud, OneTrust, CRM platforms, CDPs, and other enterprise systems.
* Work closely with technical teams to ensure effective implementation of APIs, webhooks, data flows, and marketing automation workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, campaign effectiveness, platform scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Drive Agile product delivery through sprint planning, backlog refinement, stakeholder reviews, and release management.
* Define product success metrics, track KPIs, and continuously optimize platform capabilities based on business outcomes and user feedback.
* Ensure effective stakeholder communication, manage dependencies, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

  
**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives including establishing marketing programs for new products or enhancements

* Implement change delivery solutions for the portfolio's technology process work of low to moderate complexity
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations of global market dynamics, trends, and regulatory impact

* 5+ years of Product Management, product development, strategic planning, process management, change delivery experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the global leader in AI-powered enablement, empowering go-to-market leaders to drive strategic growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Seismic Enablement Cloud™ is the only unified AI-powered platform that prepares customer-facing teams with the skills, content, tools, and insights needed to maximize every buyer interaction and strengthen client relationships. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations worldwide, Seismic helps businesses achieve measurable outcomes and accelerate revenue growth. Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Learn more at seismic.com.

**Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic** **here****.**

Overview:

We’re seeking a forward-thinking Director of Product Design who is passionate about solving complex problems in a highly customer-centric way. You will lead teams in the creation of world-class experiences, based on our customer needs and our business goals.

The Seismic Product Design team is a diverse, fun, hard-working, creative, and highly collaborative group. Each designer brings their unique perspective to help us realize our goal of solving users' needs by designing software that is driven by empathy and validated with data. We have a strong focus on continuous learning and growth and seek to leave everything a little better than we found it. If you are passionate about people and design, enjoy working with others on complex problems, and are excited about the prospect of joining a dynamic and visionary team - let’s chat!

Who you are::

* 10+ years in product design, 5+ years of experience managing design teams with demonstrated success
* A strong leader who can inspire and motivate designers to deliver their best work while also making it enjoyable
* Expertise in design thinking, usability laws, workshop creation and facilitation in complex B2B or B2C products
* A skilled coach, mentor and teacher
* Exceptional collaborator with product management, engineering and design teams
* Driven to move quickly, make decisive decisions, and support teams to deliver world-class user experiences
* Excellent communication skills, including verbal, written, and visual communication, with the ability to influence and build consensus across all levels of the organization
* Able to interact with many stakeholders and balance a multitude of inputs, including user and business needs, while planning and allocating resources effectively
* Experience working with Figma, design systems and JIRA
* Pragmatic understanding of AI capabilities
* Please include a resume and portfolio as part of your application. Applications without portfolio won’t be accepted.

  
What you'll be doing::

* Provide thought-leadership in design for developing delightful experiences by setting the design strategy and vision for your strategic area
* Deliver a cohesive experience across different platform verticals
* Coach and advocate for your team—inspiring and elevating them to their best potential by providing regular feedback and guidance
* Contribute to shared initiatives and operational improvements that drive positive impact for the team at large
* Oversee and manage design delivery for product features and new product development
* Ensure organizational visibility into the work your team is doing and facilitate collaboration with the wider design team
* Collaborate with product managers and technical leads by helping to frame problems, validate assumptions, identifying learning goals, and scoping product design work
* Plan and facilitate workshops that teach and socialize design best practices, user research and experience strategy
* Provide timely feedback, support, and guidance for your team on process and work
* Minimize and/or remove roadblocks for individual contributors to enable them to do their best work
* Identify opportunities for individual’s professional growth and development

What you bring to the team::

* Design maturity to the design team and to the rest of the organization
* Strong point of view balanced with the ability to compromise
* Inspiration that gets the best of every team an individual
* Anticipate bandwidth needs and effective planning
* Excellent communication and collaboration
* Active listening and ability to understand the "why" of every situation,
* Ability to make intentional decisions and never spin in uncertainty.
* The believe in progress, not perfection
* A passion for mentoring and developing team members, and fostering a culture of creativity and collaboration
* A people-focused approach to design that puts team members and users at the heart of everything we do
* Curiosity and a growth mindset that believes in the possibility of a better future

jobs.title: Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join a fast-paced engineering team focused on building and deploying next-generation AI agents and enterprise AI solutions.
  
The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who thrives in ambiguous environments, can rapidly translate business problems into working solutions, and is comfortable owning the entire development lifecycle—from prototyping and architecture to deployment and production operations.
  
This role requires deep technical curiosity, strong programming skills, and practical experience building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), agent orchestration frameworks, and modern cloud technologies.
  
The successful candidate will work closely with product teams, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to design, build, integrate, and deploy secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

  

Required Qualifications and Technical Skills
  

* 1–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Practical experience developing Generative AI applications, LLM-powered solutions, or intelligent AI agents.
* Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks, agentic workflows, tool calling, prompt engineering, and orchestration.
* Experience integrating LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external tools.
* Ability to design, build, deploy, and host Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent gateways, and related infrastructure to enable secure tool access, agent connectivity, and enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar technologies.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, including agent testing, response quality evaluation, tracing, and debugging.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, a Delivers routine and some non-routine platform work under moderate supervision, including minor enhancements to shared services, SDKs, or integration adapters. Troubleshoots standard issues across components using established playbooks, helping maintain reliability and backward compatibility. Monitors and analyzes platform API/SDK usage for a subsystem; proposes small improvements to observability and resilience. Updates migration notes and reference implementations within defined guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build and deploy AI agents:** Design, develop, and productionize intelligent AI agents and multi-agent workflows using modern LLMs and agent orchestration frameworks.
* **Forward deployed engineering:** Work closely with business stakeholders and product teams to identify high-value use cases, rapidly prototype solutions, and translate real-world requirements into working AI applications.
* **Own end-to-end delivery:** Take responsibility for solution design, coding, integration, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* **Build enterprise integrations:** Develop APIs, connectors, and integration services that allow AI agents to securely access enterprise data, applications, and business workflows.
* **Implement agent orchestration:** Develop agentic workflows involving reasoning, planning, tool calling, context management, and coordination across multiple agents and services.
* **Develop MCP servers and agent gateways:** Build, host, configure, and operate MCP servers, agent gateways, and secure tool integration layers that enable AI agents to interact with enterprise systems and external services.
* **Evaluate and optimize AI solutions:** Build evaluation pipelines, test agent behavior, measure quality and reliability, and optimize latency, performance, and cost.
* **Deploy production-ready AI services:** Package, deploy, and operate AI applications using cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and appropriate monitoring tools.
* **Implement security and governance:** Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise requirements for authentication, authorization, data privacy, access controls, observability, and operational reliability.
* **Drive rapid experimentation:** Explore emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns, turning promising ideas into practical, scalable solutions.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Partner with product managers, architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to deliver AI capabilities that solve meaningful business problems.

jobs.description:
TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

Manager, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Platform Reliability

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly technical and delivery-focused Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Manager to lead enterprise reliability, observability, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. The ideal candidate combines a strong software engineering background with proven experience delivering large-scale technology solutions, modern platform architectures, cloud-native services, and AI-driven operational capabilities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can bridge software development, architecture, operations, platform engineering, and business outcomes while driving reliability, scalability, security, and cost optimization across the technology landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Solution Delivery

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology solutions from architecture through production support.
* Establish engineering best practices including CI/CD, automation, resiliency, observability, and operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and Development teams to deliver scalable and reliable platforms.
* Drive platform modernization, cloud adoption, and operational transformation initiatives.

Reliability & Observability

* Define and implement SRE practices including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, capacity planning, and service health management.
* Build enterprise observability strategies covering logs, metrics, traces, events, and telemetry.
* Standardize monitoring and operational governance using industry best practices and OpenTelemetry standards.
* Improve reliability through automation, proactive monitoring, and intelligent alerting.

AIOps, Automation & AI Enablement

* Drive adoption of AIOps, event correlation, automated remediation, root cause analysis, and predictive operations.
* Enable AI-powered operational capabilities including AI Agents, RAG solutions, operational copilots, and intelligent automation.
* Partner with AI, Data, and Engineering teams to establish observability and governance standards for AI platforms.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Build and lead high-performing engineering teams focused on reliability and operational excellence.
* Present technology strategy, operational health, KPIs, risks, and investment recommendations to senior leadership.
* Manage vendors, technology roadmaps, platform investments, and value realization initiatives.
* Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

Required Qualifications

* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Solution Delivery.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams.
* Strong software development background with experience designing and delivering enterprise applications and platforms.
* Proven experience leading large-scale program delivery and cross-functional technology initiatives.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, APIs, integration patterns, automation, and operational excellence.
* Experience with Observability, AIOps, Service Management, and Incident Management practices.

Preferred Technical Skills

* Azure Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD
* Splunk, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry
* ServiceNow, Automation Platforms, Workflow Engineering
* AIOps Platforms and Event Correlation Solutions
* AI/RAG Architecture, Azure AI Search, Vector Databases
* Platform Engineering, Reliability Engineering, FinOps
* Enterprise Architecture, Integration Architecture, API Design

What Success Looks Like

* Improved platform availability, reliability, and customer experience.
* Increased automation and reduced operational toil.
* Standardized observability and telemetry across the enterprise.
* Measurable reduction in incidents, MTTR, and operational costs.
* Successful delivery of strategic modernization, AI, and platform engineering initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A technology leader who has grown from Software Engineer to Solution Architect/Engineering Leader and now drives SRE, Observability, AIOps, Platform Engineering, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Reliability at scale. This is not a traditional operations manager role; it is an engineering-first leadership role focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and intelligent technology platforms.

isolved connects its HR, payroll, and benefits platform to a growing network of strategic partners. jobs.description:
Overview:

**About JAGGAER**

JAGGAER is a global provider of AI-powered procurement software for complex sourcing, supply and spend. More than 1,400 global enterprises across manufacturing, public sector, higher education and other industries use our platform to manage sourcing, contracts, invoicing, payments and supplier relationships in one place.

JAGGAER One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Our platform supports a supplier community of more than 13 million and manages $2.9 trillion in annual spend.

Behind the technology is a global team guided by our TEAM values: Transparency, Entrepreneurial Spirit, Accountability and Metrics-Driven Results.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com.

**Principal Product Manager - Contracts**

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

The Principal Product Manager - Contracts will be the senior individual-contributor product leader for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities. The role will own product discovery, strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional execution for experiences that connect procurement, legal, finance, business stakeholders, and suppliers across the contract lifecycle. This position exists to improve customer outcomes, accelerate innovation, and strengthen the role of contract data and AI-enabled insights across the Source-to-Pay platform.

Principal Responsibilities:

**Principal Responsibilities**
==============================

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities.
* Develop deep understanding of customer workflows across contract request, authoring, review, approval, negotiation, execution, repository, obligations, amendments, renewals, and analytics.
* Lead customer discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and validation to identify high-value problems and emerging opportunities.
* Translate validated needs into product outcomes, user journeys, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success indicators.
* Prioritize roadmap and backlog decisions using customer impact, strategic alignment, technical feasibility, risk, adoption potential, and commercial value.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, Security, AI & Data, and domain experts to guide solution design and predictable delivery.
* Drive integration and workflow alignment with Sourcing, Supplier Management, Supplier Intelligence, Procure-to-Pay, analytics, enterprise systems, and relevant technology partners.
* Identify responsible opportunities for AI-assisted contract work, document intelligence, risk insight, obligation visibility, and decision support.
* Facilitate scope decisions and alignment across senior stakeholders, clearly communicating trade-offs, dependencies, and roadmap rationale.
* Lead go-to-market readiness for new and enhanced capabilities through positioning input, enablement, demonstrations, release content, and customer-facing expertise.
* Measure product performance through adoption, usage, task completion, customer satisfaction, retention, and business-impact indicators.
* Act as a product-management role model by mentoring colleagues, improving product practices, and influencing cross-portfolio standards without requiring formal people-management authority.

**Success in this Position**
============================

* A clear, customer-validated Contracts strategy and roadmap is understood and supported across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.
* Priority capabilities improve usability, adoption, customer satisfaction, and the value customers obtain from contract data and workflows.
* Engineering teams receive clear product context, requirements, priorities, and timely decisions that support predictable delivery.
* The Contracts experience is well integrated with the broader Source-to-Pay platform and differentiated in customer and prospect conversations.

Position Requirements:

**Must Have**

* Typically 7+ years of product-management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, including end-to-end ownership of complex product capabilities.
* Strong domain experience in contract lifecycle management, procurement technology, legal technology, commercial contracting, or Source-to-Pay software.
* Practical understanding of enterprise contract workflows, user groups, governance needs, integrations, and adoption challenges.
* Demonstrated success leading discovery, setting strategy, prioritizing roadmaps, and launching enterprise software products.
* Strong knowledge of software development lifecycles, agile product delivery, UX collaboration, and effective partnership with Engineering.
* Analytical and metrics-driven approach to product decisions, including customer evidence, usage insights, and business outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels without formal authority.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across time zones and travel periodically for customer and internal meetings.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in legal operations, commercial contracting, procurement transformation, or enterprise content/document products.
* Experience with AI, natural-language processing, document intelligence, e-signature ecosystems, or contract-data integrations.
* Experience working across European and Indian product or engineering teams.

  **What We Offer:**

  At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

  **Our Values - T.E.A.M:**

  At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we …

jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Sr. Devops Engineer, Senior Associate

  
  

**Role Summary & Role Description**

We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our agile team. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products, with a focus on Devop practice

  
  

Candidate must have 4+ years of relevant experience in Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure

Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Harness

Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployments using Kubernetes and Helm

Develop and manage infrastructure using Terraform / Terraform Enterprise (TFE)

Automate build, deployment, and release processes for multiple environments

Ensure platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security

Integrate security and compliance tools such as BlackDuck and Veracode into CI/CD pipelines

Collaborate with development, QA, and security teams to support application delivery

Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and runtime issues

Create and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks

  
  

**Core/Must have skills**

Good knowledge in Devops concepts and different CI/CD tools like Azure Devops and Harness

Strong experience in Kubernetes(AKS), IAC using Terraform/Terraform enterprise

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services

CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, Harness

Container technologies: Docker

Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm

Infrastructure as Code: Terraform / Terraform Enterprise (TFE)

  
  
  

**Good to have skills**

Good knowledge on Azure Databricks,Snowflake,Python scription.

**Work Schedule**

On-premise / Hybrid

**Keywords (If any)**

Devops, Azure and Terraform

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

  
  

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

  
  

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

  
  
  

**About State Street**

  

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

  
  

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

  
  

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

  
  

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Do you want to help build the operating system for Frontier Transformation?

Microsoft Frontier Company helps customers achieve measurable business outcomes through AI, engineering, and transformation at scale. Within Frontier Company Operations, Business Excellence advances its vision through a portfolio of capabilities and organizations, with Delivery Excellence (DE) serving as the AI-native operating system for how we pursue, deliver, govern, and realize customer value, with speed, quality, predictability, and financial discipline built into every engagement.

Execution Engineering is the Intelligence pillar and engineering arm of Delivery Excellence, building the intelligent products, platforms, agents, and experiences that power this operating system.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager with strong program and product management experience, you will own a problem area end-to-end, from customer and user insight to product vision, roadmap, and the cross-functional execution that ships it.

You will partner across business, engineering, and operations to identify opportunities, shape strategy, and deliver intelligent products, platforms, agents, and experiences that drive measurable outcomes. You will be responsible for translating ambiguous challenges into scalable solutions that improve how we pursue opportunities, deliver engagements, govern execution, and realize customer value. This is an individual contributor role.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products, platforms, agents, and experiences, grounded in user needs, telemetry, and business priorities.

* Discover and frame problems: synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market trends into prioritized problem statements and testable hypotheses.

* Define success criteria and outcome metrics (KPIs), and partner with Engineering to build the telemetry needed to measure them.

* Partner with Engineering, Design, and Architecture to translate the roadmap into shippable increments, making clear tradeoffs on scope, sequencing, and value.

* Drive product execution end-to-end, managing dependencies, risks, stakeholder alignment, and delivery from concept through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

* Lead product launch and adoption: Own go-to-market readiness, preview programs, documentation, enablement, and feedback loops, partnering with business, engineering, and operational stakeholders to drive adoption and continuously improve the user experience.

* Champion AI-first and agentic experiences while ensuring quality, security, privacy, compliance, Responsible AI, and operational excellence are built into every solution.

* Drive platform thinking, knowledge capture, and IP reuse by identifying common patterns, shared capabilities, and reusable assets that can scale across products and teams.

* Communicate strategy, progress, and impact to leaders and stakeholders, building consensus in a highly matrixed, global environment.

* Drive user experience, and strong enforcement and adherence to hygiene, security, and compliance requirements of the organization.

* Contribute to organizational strategy, helping shape priorities, operating models, roadmaps, and investment decisions that advance the broader mission of Business Excellence and Delivery Excellence.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, consolidate, and modernize fragmented processes, tools, and experiences into scalable, AI-native capabilities that improve business outcomes

 **Qualifications**

Required / Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree AND c OR equivalent experience.

* 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects or products.

Preferred Qualifications

* Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics, while driving complex cross-functional execution from concept through adoption.

* Experience with AI/GenAI, LLMs, or agentic workflows; DevOps and/or knowledge-management practices; and data-informed decision-making.

* Demonstrated ability to translate customer, user, and business needs into product strategy, requirements, and scalable solutions, balancing user value, business priorities, technical constraints, and operational considerations to achieve measurable outcomes.

* Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority across a global, matrixed organization.

* Responsible for self-development on latest trends/developments in the related role/work profile according to professional development plan.

* Experience leading large-scale organizational change, transformation initiatives, or adoption programs across distributed teams and stakeholder groups

* Must have a proven record of managing and executing work through large vendor teams and outsourced partners.

* Outstanding interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment, inspire teams, and drive execution across diverse stakeholder communities.
* Experience leveraging telemetry, experimentation, user feedback, and business metrics to inform product decisions and measure impact.

  PMP, Scrum (CSM/CSPO), SAFe, ITIL, Product Management, or related certifications are a plus

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, FAI Asset Creation Technology (FACT)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will own and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle complex technical problems, bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, and craft solutions that are simple, maintainable, and built to scale. This is a role where your engineering contributions have direct, visible impact on the products and experiences our customers rely on every day. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on collaboration and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, working across the full development lifecycle including scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
* Write high-quality, well-documented, and maintainable code while actively participating in code reviews to provide meaningful feedback and mentor fellow engineers on your team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and software reliability.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches—including generative AI capabilities—to recommend and adopt improvements that enhance productivity and solution quality.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a design discussion where you sketch out the architecture for a new feature, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability with your teammates. After lunch, you could be deep in code, building and testing a component that will ship incrementally to customers. Between focused coding sessions, you review pull requests from peers, share constructive feedback, and help onboard a new team member by walking them through how your services operate and fit into the broader system.  
  
About the team  
Our team is committed to building reliable, customer-focused software that operates at Amazon scale. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective is heard. Whether you are refactoring existing systems or launching new capabilities, you will be part of a group that invests in long-term quality and encourages continuous growth. We are excited about the road ahead and looking for engineers who want to help shape what comes next.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Manager, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Platform Reliability

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly technical and delivery-focused Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Manager to lead enterprise reliability, observability, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. The ideal candidate combines a strong software engineering background with proven experience delivering large-scale technology solutions, modern platform architectures, cloud-native services, and AI-driven operational capabilities.

Engineering & Solution Delivery

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology solutions from architecture through production support.

* Partner with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and Development teams to deliver scalable and reliable platforms.

Reliability & Observability

jobs.description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath.
* Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked.
* Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them.
* Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization.
* Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause.
* Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own.
* Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on.
* Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule.

### **AI-driven development (AIDLC)**

The team follows an AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC): coding agents take part in every stage of delivery, and engineers direct, check and own the result. This is a core requirement of the role, not a preference.

You will be expected to:

* Use coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor every day, across requirements, design, implementation, testing, code review and debugging.
* Turn a user story into a clear, bounded task an agent can carry out: the goal, the constraints, the files and data involved, and how success will be checked.
* Plan before generating: have the agent propose an approach, challenge it, and agree the design before code is written.
* Verify everything an agent produces. Read the diff, run the tests, exercise the change in the running application, and reject work you cannot explain.
* Own what you merge. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand, and you answer for it in review and in production.
* Keep credentials, customer data and other sensitive information out of prompts and agent context, and follow PDI's AI usage policies.
* Improve the team's shared setup: project instructions, reusable prompts and skills, test fixtures and other context that make agents more reliable for everyone.
* Know when not to use an agent and recognize when one is going in circles or producing plausible but wrong output.

### **Required Skills & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field plus 4 to 6 years of experience building or maintaining software in a product development environment, or equivalent experience.
* Working proficiency in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core), including building and consuming REST APIs.
* Working proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework with TypeScript; React is preferred.
* Solid SQL skills on a relational database (SQL Server or PostgreSQL): queries, stored procedures and basic performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience using coding agents or AI coding assistants in real project work, and the ability to show how you directed and verified their output.
* Computer science fundamentals: object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* Practical experience with Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery.
* Habit of writing automated tests for your own code.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts in non-technical terms. Clear writing matters more here than usual, because it is also how you direct agents.
* Self-starter who can work independently as part of a distributed team, manage competing priorities and learn an unfamiliar codebase quickly.

### **Other Skills and Experience:**

* AWS experience: Lambda, SQS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
* Experience building agent workflows: custom instructions, skills, MCP servers or agent-run test and review loops.
* React Native or Expo mobile development.
* Payments or subscription billing integrations, such as Stripe.
* Retail, convenience store, point-of-sale…

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will own and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle complex technical problems, bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, and craft solutions that are simple, maintainable, and built to scale. This is a role where your engineering contributions have direct, visible impact on the products and experiences our customers rely on every day. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on collaboration and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, working across the full development lifecycle including scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
* Write high-quality, well-documented, and maintainable code while actively participating in code reviews to provide meaningful feedback and mentor fellow engineers on your team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and software reliability.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches—including generative AI capabilities—to recommend and adopt improvements that enhance productivity and solution quality.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a design discussion where you sketch out the architecture for a new feature, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability with your teammates. After lunch, you could be deep in code, building and testing a component that will ship incrementally to customers. Between focused coding sessions, you review pull requests from peers, share constructive feedback, and help onboard a new team member by walking them through how your services operate and fit into the broader system.  
  
About the team  
Our team is committed to building reliable, customer-focused software that operates at Amazon scale. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective is heard. Whether you are refactoring existing systems or launching new capabilities, you will be part of a group that invests in long-term quality and encourages continuous growth. We are excited about the road ahead and looking for engineers who want to help shape what comes next.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
Prompt Engineer – Generative AI  
Role Purpose  
Centrica is looking for an experienced Prompt Engineer – Generative AI to design, develop, evaluate and optimise prompt based solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.  
The role will work closely with product, engineering, data and business teams to translate real business problems into effective AI experiences and workflows.  
The Prompt Engineer will take ownership of prompt design, prompt optimisation, evaluation, testing and guardrails, helping move Generative AI use cases from experimentation and proof of concept into reliable, secure and scalable production solutions.  
The role requires a combination of strong analytical capability, understanding of LLM behaviour, hands on prompt engineering, experimentation, evaluation and sufficient technical knowledge to work effectively with AI engineers and software development teams.  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Prompt Engineering & Optimisation  
  
. Design, develop and optimise prompts for Large Language Models and Generative AI applications.  
. Create reusable prompt templates and prompt patterns for different business use cases.  
. Apply techniques including: Zero shot prompting Few shot prompting Structured prompting Contextual prompting Role/task based prompting Tool/function oriented prompting  
. Experiment systematically with different prompt structures, instructions and context.  
. Improve output accuracy, consistency, relevance and reliability.  
. Reduce hallucinations and undesirable model behaviour.  
. Optimise prompts considering quality, latency and token/cost efficiency.  
  
2. Generative AI Solution Development  
  
. Work with AI and software engineers to build Generative AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.  
. Translate business requirements into effective LLM based interactions and workflows.  
. Support use cases such as: Enterprise knowledge assistants Customer/service agent assistance Document summarisation and analysis Information extraction Classification Content generation Question answering Workflow automation Decision support applications  
. Help move Generative AI capabilities from experimentation into production ready solutions.  
  
3. LLM Evaluation & Testing  
  
. Develop systematic approaches for evaluating prompt and model performance.  
. Define evaluation criteria covering: Accuracy Relevance Completeness Consistency Groundedness Hallucination Safety Response quality  
. Build representative evaluation datasets and test scenarios.  
. Conduct comparative testing across prompts, models and configurations.  
. Perform regression testing following prompt or model changes.  
. Analyse failure patterns and identify opportunities for improvement.  
. Establish measurable acceptance criteria before prompts are promoted into production.  
  
4. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)  
  
. Work with engineering teams to design prompts for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.  
. Optimise how retrieved enterprise context is supplied to LLMs.  
. Design system and user prompts that encourage grounded responses based on approved information.  
. Support optimisation of retrieval and generation workflows.  
. Evaluate whether responses are properly grounded in retrieved source material.  
. Help identify whether poor results originate from retrieval, context, prompt design or the underlying model.  
  
5. Prompt Libraries & Reusable Patterns  
  
. Develop and maintain a governed library of reusable prompt templates.  
. Define standard patterns for common Generative AI use cases.  
. Maintain appropriate prompt documentation and version history.  
. Ensure prompt changes can be tested, reviewed and traced.  
. Promote reuse rather than duplication across AI solutions.  
. Capture lessons learned and effective prompting practices for wider engineering teams.  
  
6. Responsible AI, Safety & Guardrails  
  
. Ensure prompt based solutions comply with Centrica's security, privacy, governance and responsible AI requirements.  
. Design appropriate safeguards against: Prompt injection Jailbreak attempts Hallucination Sensitive information disclosure Harmful or inappropriate outputs Unintended model behaviour  
. Define system level instructions and constraints for production AI applications.  
. Work with Security, Data and AI Governance stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks.  
. Support testing for bias, safety, privacy and explainability.  
. Ensure human oversight is incorporated where appropriate.  
  
7. Business Requirement Translation  
  
. Work directly with business and product stakeholders to understand problems that could benefit from Generative AI.  
. Translate business requirements into clear AI tasks and prompt strategies.  
. Facilitate discovery and experimentation sessions with users.  
. Understand user journeys and determine where AI can genuinely improve outcomes.  
. Challenge use cases where Generative AI may not be the appropriate solution.  
. Convert user feedback into measurable prompt and solution improvements.  
  
8. AI Experimentation  
  
. Experiment with different Large Language Models and model configurations.  
. Compare models based on: Output quality Accuracy Reasoning capability Latency Cost Security Context window requirements  
. Conduct controlled experiments to determine the most effective approach for each use case.  
. Document findings and provide evidence based recommendations.  
. Stay current with developments in LLMs, Generative AI and prompt engineering techniques.  
  
9. Production AI & Monitoring  
  
. Work with AI engineering teams to integrate prompts into production applications and services.  
. Ensure prompts are version controlled and deployed through appropriate engineering processes.  
. Define monitoring requirements for prompt/model performance.  
. Analyse production feedback and failure patterns.

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About the Technology Organization
  
Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting-edge technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose — creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data-driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise.
  
Role Details
  
The Senior Service Operations Lead is a senior, hands-on leadership role that owns day-to-day service operations across the Tech@Lilly Service Desk and the Autonomous Operations Team — a centralized, automation-first support layer that gives applications a single, increasingly self-running point of support. You will run the shift floor, lead a small, high-impact team that covers a large scope with relatively few people, represent the support organization in leadership forums, and design how service is delivered end to end. You will also shape the portfolio, product and strategy of the support offering, treating support as a product that is continuously improved, automated and scaled.
  
Because the team is small, scale comes from automation and AI rather than headcount. Roughly 30% of the role is AI Ops with Claude — hands-on building that includes automating workflows, creating dashboards, using skills and plugins, and building integrations and connectors that make operations faster and more autonomous. This role suits someone who has led support operations at scale, thinks in terms of products and portfolios, communicates confidently with senior stakeholders, and is energized by using AI to change how the work gets done.
  
**Indicative time allocation:** Service operations & shift management 20% · People leadership & talent management 10% · Leadership representation, communication & stakeholders 10% · Service delivery design 10% · Portfolio management, agile delivery, strategy & site initiatives 15% · Quality, insights & continuous improvement 5% · AI Ops with Claude 30%.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Service Operations & Shift Management — Service Desk and Autonomous Operations (20%)
  
  

* Own operational performance across Service Desk and the Autonomous Operations Team, ensuring full shift coverage, balanced workloads, and SLA/OLA adherence in a global 24×7 model.
* Monitor real-time queues and application health, prioritize high-impact issues, and manage major incidents and escalations through to resolution and review.
* Coordinate with peer shift and regional leads for seamless handoffs; maintain shift logs and flag operational, capacity and performance risks early.
* Stay close to the work: step in on complex or sensitive cases, and use ITSM, remote desktop and endpoint tooling to diagnose and unblock the team when it matters.

People Leadership & Talent Management — Small, High-Impact Team (10%)
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop a small, multi-skilled team that supports a large scope with limited people, using sharp prioritization, cross-training, flexible rostering and automation to deliver more with fewer resources.
* Set goals, give timely and constructive feedback, run performance conversations, and build succession and growth paths for team members.
* Manage workforce planning, shift rosters, onboarding and training so coverage and capability stay strong with limited headcount as demand and scope grow.
* Own talent management for the team: capability mapping, talent and performance reviews, succession and retention, hiring, and upskilling — including AI and automation fluency — so people grow into higher-value roles as routine work is automated.
* Contribute to training materials and agent onboarding, and coach peers to raise the standard.

Leadership Representation, Communication & Stakeholder Partnership (10%)
  
  

* Represent Service Desk and Autonomous Operations in leadership and governance forums, presenting performance, risks, roadmap and investment needs with clarity and credibility.
* Partner with Service Desk Leads, Automation, Knowledge Management, application owners, product teams, infrastructure, security, vendors and business stakeholders to drive frontline excellence and resolve cross-team issues.
* Act as the escalation point for senior stakeholders; communicate transparently during major incidents and drive follow-through on corrective actions.
* Drive adoption of quality benchmarks, documentation expectations and support procedures, and help scale best practices globally.

Service Delivery Design (10%)
  
  

* Design and evolve the service delivery model for Service Desk and Autonomous Operations: tiering and routing, SLAs/OLAs, escalation paths, runbooks, handoffs and ways of working with application teams.
* Define the onboarding standard for applications moving into autonomous support — support readiness, knowledge, monitoring, access, automation candidates and exit criteria.

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst to lead requirements and process design for laboratory instrument connectivity and scientific data integration initiatives. You will work with scientists, laboratory operations, Quality Assurance (QA), validation teams, vendors, architects, and engineers to connect instruments and laboratory applications to enterprise platforms.

You will help shape solutions that support the full laboratory workflow, from sample registration and testing through result approval and downstream analytics. The role spans discovery, Agile delivery, user acceptance testing, and qualification in GxP-regulated environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, data, and integration requirements for laboratory connectivity and scientific data integration initiatives.
* Lead discovery workshops and requirements sessions, serving as the primary liaison between laboratory subject matter experts, business stakeholders, vendors, architects, and engineering teams.
* Map current laboratory processes and data flows, identify gaps, and design target-state workflows for sample handling, testing, data acquisition, result review, approval, and downstream data use.
* Support the onboarding of laboratory instruments and applications, including laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), and chromatography data systems (CDS), into enterprise platforms.
* Contribute to solution evaluations, integration assessments, and architecture reviews. Help define repeatable approaches for onboarding instruments and applications at scale.
* Drive business analysis activities throughout Agile delivery, including backlog refinement and prioritization, user story and acceptance criteria development, user acceptance testing (UAT), and stakeholder sign-off.
* Support qualification and validation by authoring qualification documentation, leading informal and formal testing, and documenting test results and evidence in collaboration with QA and validation teams.

  
**Requirements**  

**Skills and Expertise**
------------------------

* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and solution assessment.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end laboratory workflows, including sample registration, testing, data acquisition, result review, approval, and use of scientific data for analytics and decision-making.
* Hands-on experience with laboratory informatics systems such as LabWare LIMS, IDBS or Revvity Signals ELN, and Chromeleon CDS.
* Understanding of laboratory instrument workflows and how data moves between instruments, CDS, LIMS, ELN, enterprise data platforms, and analytics applications.
* Experience with system integrations, APIs, data mapping, interoperability, metadata management, and enterprise data platforms.
* Knowledge of GxP, ALCOA+ data integrity principles, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11.
* Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate laboratory needs into clear requirements for technical teams.

**Experience and Qualifications**
---------------------------------

* At least eight years of IT business analysis experience.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or R&D laboratory environments.
* Proven delivery experience in laboratory digitalization, scientific data integration, or interoperability programs.
* Experience collaborating with laboratory operations, QA, validation teams, vendors, and IT delivery teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, engineering, life sciences, or a related field.

This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for taking products from **problem discovery and ideation to strategy, roadmap, development, launch, measurement, and continuous optimisation**.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Product leadership while being accountable for business outcomes such as **engagement, retention, activation, and conversion**.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the **product/domain end-to-end**, from identifying customer problems to delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics.
* Conduct product discovery using user research, behavioural data, and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion.
* Analyse funnels, cohorts, user journeys, and product performance to identify drop-offs and growth opportunities.
* Create clear **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design teams to plan, build, launch, and iterate features.
* Make product prioritisation and trade-off decisions based on customer value and business impact.
* Drive the complete product lifecycle: **Discovery → Strategy → Roadmap → Development → Launch → Measurement → Optimisation**.
* Design and run **A/B tests and product experiments** and use learnings to improve the product.
* Monitor product KPIs and continuously optimise product performance.
* Align cross-functional teams and stakeholders around product direction and priorities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **3–5 years of Product Management experience** in a **B2C / consumer digital product**.
* Proven experience in **end-to-end product ownership**.
* Ability to independently own a product/domain and drive it from **problem identification to measurable business results**.
* Strong understanding of **Product Strategy, Product Vision, Product Roadmapping, Product Discovery, and Product Execution**.
* Strong **product sense** and ability to identify high-impact customer problems.
* Strong **data-driven decision-making** and product analytics skills.
* Hands-on experience with **Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar product analytics tools**.
* Strong understanding of **funnels, cohorts, user journeys, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion metrics**.
* Experience with **A/B testing, experimentation, hypothesis-driven product development, and iteration**.
* Strong skills in writing **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Strong **prioritisation and stakeholder management** skills.
* Ability to make product trade-offs based on **customer impact, business value, data, and technical feasibility**.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align **Engineering, Design, Product, and Leadership**.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to **ship products/features from concept to production**.
* Ability to take complete ownership of problems and drive them to resolution **without requiring constant supervision**.
* Comfortable working in a **fast-paced Agile product development environment**.

Nice to Have

* Experience in **EdTech, E-learning, LMS, or consumer learning products**.
* Experience in **Growth, Lifecycle, Engagement, or Retention Product Management**.
* Experience working on **customer acquisition and activation funnels**.
* Experience shipping products across **Web and Mobile (iOS/Android)**.
* Experience working in a **high-growth consumer technology/product company**.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who **owns outcomes, not just a backlog**.

You should be comfortable taking a problem, understanding the customer, defining the right solution, building the roadmap, working with Engineering and Design, launching the product, analysing results, and continuously improving it.

**End-to-end ownership of the product is a core requirement for this role.**

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in consumer product company??

Experience:

* Product management: 3 years (Required)
* End-To-End ownership of the Product: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

The Oracle Health Medication Administration team delivers solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is a critical part of care delivery, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.

Our mission is to support and improve the medication administration capabilities customers depend on every day. We focus on product reliability, effective clinical workflows, customer responsiveness, and practical enhancements that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety.

We are seeking a **Product Manager 2** to support medication administration products and contributing to requirements definition and product development for medication administration. This role emphasizes understanding current customer workflows, helping address product issues, documenting requirements, validating solutions, and supporting release readiness and adoption. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering, UX, regulatory & compliance, support, consulting, and customer-facing teams.

Working with guidance from senior team members, you will contribute to product decisions and roadmap priorities for assigned capabilities.
