jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authentication - India
jobs.description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role:**

Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud’s Access & Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you’ll define how millions of users prove who they are. You’ll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you’ll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren’t a tradeoff, join us.

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.

If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let’s have a conversation.

  

### **You’ll be responsible for:**

* Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.
* Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.
* Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

### **You Have:**

* 5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.
* Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.
* A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.
* Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

### **Bonus Points for:**

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

#LI-PD1

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Overview**

Microsoft's 1P Privacy team builds and operates large-scale privacy infrastructure that enables Microsoft products and services to meet global privacy and regulatory requirements.

Our platforms power data discovery, classification, governance, and Data Subject Request (DSR) processing across Microsoft's extensive data ecosystem.

We are transforming our privacy platforms by simplifying complex workflows, modernizing infrastructure, and leveraging AI and automation to make privacy compliance more efficient, reliable, and scalable.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about building technically sophisticated products, solving complex customer problems, and driving meaningful product outcomes.

In this role, you will own key product capabilities within the 1P Privacy ecosystem, working closely with engineering, security, compliance, and partner teams across Microsoft.

You will be responsible for translating customer needs and business priorities into clear product requirements, driving execution, and delivering measurable improvements in product adoption, usability, and compliance effectiveness.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Independently own and deliver meaningful product capabilities.

* Develop a deep understanding of customer problems and translate them into effective product solutions.

* Drive measurable improvements in product adoption, usability, and operational efficiency.

* Build strong partnerships with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Make sound product decisions by balancing technical complexity, customer needs, and business priorities.

* Consistently deliver high-quality product outcomes while contributing to the broader 1P Privacy strategy.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically strong product manager who enjoys working closely with engineering teams to solve complex problems.

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, understanding technical systems, engaging with customers, and translating complex requirements into clear product direction.

You take ownership, make thoughtful decisions, collaborate effectively, and focus on delivering meaningful customer and business impact.

 **Responsibilities**

Product Strategy and Ownership

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned capabilities within the 1P Privacy platform.

* Identify customer problems, define product requirements, and prioritize investments based on customer value, compliance impact, and engineering feasibility.

* Drive product initiatives independently from problem discovery through development, launch, and adoption.

* Make informed prioritization decisions by balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business objectives.

* Define success metrics and continuously evaluate product effectiveness.

Technical Product Management

* Participate in technical design discussions, understand architectural trade-offs, and influence product decisions.

**Product Mgr II**

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. We value curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement, and are committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

  

**About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. From there, you'll grow into progressively larger scope, working toward owning the full arc of discovery, delivery, and outcomes for your own product area.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

* Own go-to-market and ongoing support for your features, including release plans and stakeholder communications for your product area
* Own how success metrics are defined and calculated, including adoption after release, ensuring they reflect business outcomes.

**Requirements:-**

jobs.company_description:
Founded by two IIT-Delhi graduates, Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwal in 2015, Meesho is India’s only true e-commerce marketplace. Meesho, which stands for "meri shop" or "my shop", connects millions of consumers with small sellers across India.
India’s unorganized retail represents a c.$800bn+ Target Addressable Market (TAM), which is 80-85% of the overall retail sector. In India, e-Commerce is expected to grow to c.$170-180bn by 2027 (c.35% CAGR ‘22-’27) led by nearly 500mm online shoppers in India, versus the current c.200mm base. This growth is expected to be led by consumers who are transitioning directly from unorganized trade to e-Commerce, especially those in the rising middle class of India. Meesho’s differentiated business model focuses on the underserved small sellers and value-first consumers. Leveraging tech innovations, seller-friendly policies and an asset-light structure, the platform has emerged as the lowest-cost destination catering to India’s price-conscious customers.
With a vision to be the e-Commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable 100 million small businesses to succeed online, Meesho is democratizing internet commerce in India. The company provides sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and the lowest shipping cost. Over 1.4 million sellers are registered on Meesho, growing their business by tapping the company’s massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, pan-India logistics at the lowest cost through third-party logistics providers in an ‘Everyday Lowest Cost’ channel for sellers.
With ~80% of Meesho’s 140 million annual transacting customers coming from tier 2+ cities and towns, the company has been instrumental in bringing new-to-e-commerce users online. Meesho has made e-Commerce more accessible, affordable and engaging for a unique and underserved ‘non-affluent’ user segment. With a strong value proposition of Everyday Lowest Prices, the platform hosts one of the largest selection of unique products (>65% product listings are unique to Meesho).
Meesho has so far raised ~$1.1 billion and was valued at c.$5 billion in its last round of funding, making it one of India’s most well capitalized growth names in the consumer internet space. It was also the first Indian startup to secure funding from Meta (Facebook). Other marquee investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund, Prosus Ventures, Elevation Capital, Sequoia Capital, Fidelity and BCapital Group have backed the company across multiple rounds. 

Be an agent of change. Join us today. We are hiring!

**Also, Be sure that your job offer is genuine!**

It has come to our notice that some people are using the name and logo of Meesho with a view to tarnish the image and reputation of Meesho. They are fraudulently offering jobs online on certain websites, through telephone calls or social media (Telegram, Whatsapp, Instagram etc.) and are asking people to deposit money or share personal bank information.

To prevent any more people falling victim to these frauds, we are sharing some information to help you spot genuine offers

How to identify genuine job offers?

1. During Meesho’s multi-round and merit-based employment recruitment practice, we NEVER charge, request or accept any fee or money from job seekers during or after the process.
2. Meesho will not ask for any confidential or financial information such as bank account number, tax details, recruitment fee, security deposit and similar during the selection process. After the offer letter is rolled out, the bank account details will be asked for however only send them to a ‘@meesho.com’ email address. Never share OTPs with anyone.
3. Meesho only collaborates with well-established recruitment agencies who are authorized by the company to source candidate profiles. However, they are not authorized to charge money/ fee to the applicants or to make a final job offer. 
4. Job seekers will always get a final offer from a ‘@meesho.com’ email address. 
5. If you are uncertain about the authenticity and description of the job opportunity, please visit our careers portal Meesho Careers as all our jobs are published there.
6. In case of any doubt about the interviewer, the interview process or the job description, feel free to reach out to reporthiringfraud@meesho.com to verify the authenticity of the information. 
7. If you believe you have been a victim of recruitment fraud, please contact law enforcement agencies immediately.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfort…

* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **You've shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**
------------------------

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**
------------------------------------

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**
----------------------------------------

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* **Impact over activity.** You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* **Honesty.** You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* **Independence.** You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
* **Passion.** Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.
* **Depth.** At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

jobs.title: Client Operations Delivery Analyst
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
Within the Pricing Operations team, we streamline pricing and discounting processes, leveraging exceptional data management skills, automation and tools to ensure accuracy and consistency in price and discount data. With a focus on operational excellence, we align cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Sales, Compliance, and IT to transform our policies, processes, and tool capabilities to create a simplified buying experience at scale for our partners, customers and sales.
  
  
Pricing Operations sits within the Commerce& Growth Acceleration organization, with a mission to provide frictionless commerce operations at scale for Cisco's customers, partners, sellers& renewal managers across all hardware, software, service offers and buying programs fueled by a culture where we celebrate talent& collaboration.
  
  
Your Impact
  
The Client Operations Analyst within Pricing Operations will bridge the gap between Cisco’s partner incentive discount strategy and the operational data infrastructure required to support them.
  
  
This individual will work directly with Business Units and Finance to implement and maintain Cisco’s discounting strategy across its entire portfolio of products, as well as work with Partner Incentive Owners to provide support of the strategy, setup and maintenance of high-revenue generating partner incentive offers. They will be responsible for understanding offer and sales business strategy translating it into clear data requirements to ensure correct partner prices and discounts are applied in Cisco’s commerce platform for hardware, software, service, and all subscription motions. This individual will also serve as point of contact for managing, tracking, reporting and resolving issues with the offer setups.
  
  
The Client Operations Analyst works cross-functionally to analyze business processes, identifies areas for improvement, and implements solutions that enhance productivity and drive business performance.
  
  

* Understand complex business strategies and requirements and translate into clear data requirements
* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support decision-making
* Develop, lead and participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to implement new offer setups, as well as operational changes and improvements
* Identify inefficiencies in current business processes and develop strategies to optimize workflows and operations
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product Management, and IT, to understand their operational needs and provide data-driven recommendations
* Create and maintain detailed documentation of business processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures
* Provide training and support to team members on new processes and tools

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years of relevant business analysis experience within the IT industry, including tasks such as data analysis, requirement gathering, process improvement and process automation
* Experience leading data analysis and audit projects involving large data sets, where high-level Excel skills, including the use of macros, pivots, formulas, and data slicing, were used to identify trends and insights, resulting in actional business strategies
* Demonstrate ability to analyze data from at least four different sources to identify root cause of a problem, evaluate alternative solutions, with documented success in presenting and explaining findings to cross-functional teams, leading to consensus on a strategic path forward
* Proven proficiency in process and change management, demonstrated by leading at least two change initiatives that resulted in 100% user adoption and at least 20% improvement in process efficiency
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining automated solutions that streamline sophisticated operational workflows, resulting in increased process efficiency and reduced manual intervention.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, bold, assertive and possess a sense of ownership of work you're leading
* Work independently as well as in a multi-functional team environment
* Highly organized with strong analytical and problem solving skills
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of work
* Responsive and timely in delivering on commitments

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

The person filling this role will join 3M’s world-class Global Network & Telecom Services organization as a software engineer on the Network Automation team. You will build the enterprise applications and AI-powered services that keep 3M’s global network reliable and efficient.

This is a hands-on software development role. You will design, build and ship production applications where AI is part of the solution, such as generative AI features on AWS Bedrock, agent-driven workflows, tool calling and natural-language interfaces. You will use AI code assistants every day to speed up delivery. You will work across the full stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data integrations, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. You will work alongside experienced engineers in a globally distributed team.

Network automation or network platform experience is a plus, and the team will help you learn the domain. This position requires occasional work outside normal business hours. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline (completed and verified prior to start).

* Experience building applications that integrate AI or LLM services (for example AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), or a strong aptitude to do so.
* Hands-on experience using AI code assistants in daily development.

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience building and shipping applications on AWS Bedrock, including agents, RAG, tool calling and streaming responses.
* Experience developing software in a large enterprise environment, with attention to security, compliance and change management & experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) & experience with SQL and relational databases, Graph QL, and designing/consuming APIs.

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
**Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.
* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Technical Acumen**

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

**About Our Team:-**
Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.
  
  
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role focuses on **initial diagnosis, basic troubleshooting, and customer communication**, ensuring customer issues are clearly understood, properly documented, and resolved where possible at Level‑1 or escalated effectively with thorough analysis.

You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and senior engineers while developing your technical and domain knowledge in a structured support environment.

* Gather accurate information, understand reported problems, and perform initial troubleshooting.
* Resolve **common and known issues** using documentation, knowledge bases, and standard procedures.
* Identify when issues need escalation and ensure complete and clear handover to Level‑2 teams.

### **Case Ownership & Communication**

* Take ownership of assigned support cases from initial contact until resolution or escalation.
* Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers.
* Provide timely updates and manage customer expectations effectively.
* Handle tense or challenging customer situations calmly and constructively.

### **Documentation & Process Adherence**

* Document issues, troubleshooting steps, findings, and outcomes accurately in support tools.
* Follow defined support processes, quality standards, and escalation guidelines.
* Contribute to knowledge bases by sharing learnings and known solutions where applicable.

### **Collaboration & Learning**

* Work closely with team members, Team Leaders, and other support teams across time zones.
* Participate in training, shadowing, and enablement sessions to build product and technical expertise.
* Show willingness to learn and grow towards handling more complex issues over time.

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PROFESSIONAL WHO IS:**
---------------------------------------------

* A **good communicator** with the ability to defuse tense customer situations.
* Empathetic towards colleagues, customers, and suppliers.
* Proactive in addressing problems and curious about preventing similar issues in the future.
* An excellent listener, able to understand customer needs and manage expectations.
* **Fluent in English**, both written and spoken.
* Knowledgeable about **how web applications work**, through experience or qualification.
* Comfortable working in a **24/7 support environment**.
* Willing to work **rotational shifts and weekends** as part of scheduled workdays.
* Willing to work in **hybrid mode** (office and work‑from‑home) based on team planning.

**SHIFT DETAILS**
-----------------

* **First Shift:** 03:30 AM – 12:00 PM IST
* **Second Shift:** 12:00 PM – 09:00 PM IST
* **Night Shift:** 06:30 PM – 03:30 AM IST (next day)

Weekend work (Saturday and/or Sunday) may be scheduled. These will count as regular workdays, with alternate days off provided based on schedule planning by the Team Leader.

**YOUR EDUCATION AND BACKGROUND EXPERIENCE WILL INCLUDE:**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to learn quickly.
* An analytical mindset with a calm and methodical approach to troubleshooting.

This position is responsible for entering pricing discount and rates information into FedEx enterprise pricing systems, setting necessary parameters within the FedEx pricing systems and for auditing data entered in pricing ecosystem. This position shares responsibility for planning, implementing pricing changes, and validating them for Pricing Contract administration. This role manages several pricing specific processes that support all FedEx US Domestic pricing and operating companies. This would require working with key business partners to effectively implement and audit customer’s pricing and discounting requirements, planning and streamlining pricing processes through optimization and automation – helping manage costs and achieve business efficiencies.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, CA, CFA or similar quantitative discipline. Master's degree or PhD preferred.

Standard II: Three (3) years  
Senior I: Four (4) years  
Senior II: Five (5) years  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  

* Fluency in English
* Analytical Skills
* Accuracy & Attention to Detail
* Numerical Skills
* Planning & Organizing Skills
* Presentation Skills
* Statistical Knowledge
* Data Modeling and Visualization Skills

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs.description:
As a **Quality Assurance Analyst**, you will provide independent QA governance and delivery assurance across technology projects. You will evaluate project artefacts, assess risks and issues, identify root causes of deviations, and recommend improvements to ensure projects meet quality standards, controls, and delivery expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

**What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed**

**Quality Assurance & Delivery Governance**

* Safeguard the quality of assigned projects through independent reviews and quality assurance activities.
* Verify that project goals, scope, functional requirements, technical requirements, and quality standards are met throughout the project lifecycle.
* Assess project risks, issues, and deviations from defined processes and controls.
* Recommend corrective and preventive actions to improve project quality and delivery outcomes.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across quality assurance and project delivery practices.

**Project Artefact Review & Validation**

* Review key project artefacts including BRDs, Functional Design Documents, test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test results.
* Evaluate deliverables against quality standards, governance requirements, and project objectives.
* Document review findings, observations, and recommendations.
* Work with stakeholders to address identified gaps and quality concerns.
* Provide sign-off on reviewed artefacts and project execution tollgates where appropriate.

**Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Assess compliance with SDLC, Agile, Waterfall, risk management, and control frameworks.
* Support governance reviews and ensure projects maintain audit-ready documentation.
* Review traceability, defect management processes, and testing evidence.
* Identify root causes of quality issues and provide recommendations to strengthen controls and delivery practices.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Continuous Improvement**

* Coordinate with project managers, business analysts, technology teams, QA/testing teams, and governance partners.
* Communicate findings, recommendations, and quality observations clearly to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Promote adoption of quality standards, governance practices, and delivery improvements.
* Support evaluation and adoption of new tools, technologies, and QA capabilities where required.

**We’d Love to Hear From You If...**

**Experience**

* You have 5–8 years of experience in Business Analysis and/or IT Project Management.
* You have experience working within regulated financial services environments (preferred).
* You have experience reviewing project deliverables and supporting quality assurance, governance, or delivery oversight activities.
* You have experience working with stakeholders across business, technology, testing, and project management teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* You have solid understanding of SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* You have knowledge of quality assurance frameworks, IT risk and control frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, and IT audit practices.
* You have familiarity with unit testing, SIT, UAT planning, test scenarios, test cases, traceability, and defect management processes.
* You have knowledge of IT systems, cloud technologies, and testing tools such as ALM and Zephyr.
* You have experience using Jira, Confluence, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* You have proficiency with collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint.
* You have familiarity with AI-assisted validation of documents and requirements using AI agents and prompts (preferred).
* You have strong knowledge of governance, controls, risk management, and audit-ready documentation (preferred).

**Ways of Working**

* You communicate and present effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You collaborate effectively with project managers, business analysts, developers, testers, and governance stakeholders.
* You build consensus and advocate for process improvements across teams.
* You apply structured analysis and root-cause investigation to solve complex project issues.
* You demonstrate adaptability and a willingness to learn new tools and capabilities based on business needs.
* You maintain a high level of attention to detail, accountability, and professional judgement.

The successful candidate will work directly with business stakeholders to understand workflows and business problems, identify opportunities for analytics and AI, and translate those needs into practical solutions. jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for an **Energy Market Analyst** to assist ICF in contributing to the development of innovative, accurate, timely, and high-quality products and services, typically working on multiple projects with all levels of staff. You will have the opportunity to apply academic knowledge, gain exposure to major projects, and interact with experts and clients in the field, while building content knowledge and consulting skills.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Collecting and analyzing data for power sector modeling projects (i.e., technology characterizations, regional load and energy demand data, emissions control technologies cost and performance)
* Perform production cost modeling and transmission congestion analysis of power markets
* Assist in modeling and analysis of nodal power markets including financial calculations and other standard asset valuation-related tasks
* Assist in load flow analysis of transmission and distribution systems, including steady state, contingency, and dynamic analysis
* Lead data input, output processes and maintain datasets, and templates required for nodal power markets modeling.
* Research and keep the broader group updated on latest power market developments in prominent ISO/RTO markets that influence power price forecasts, electric transmission congestion and other factors that influence power price fundamentals.
* Perform advanced quantitative analysis of transmission systems around the world to assess and forecast the future of electric reliability, transmission bottlenecks, and regulatory effects, among other parameters
* Support modeling and policy analysis related to transmission, renewable energy, smart grid and distribution
* Developing code and macros to process and manage large datasets.
* Preparing high-quality written and electronic products

**What you’ll need…**.

* A master’s degree in Power / Energy systems or a bachelor's in electrical engineering is a must.
* 0-2 years of production cost modeling, and/or economic power market analysis experience (including internships)
* Experience in production cost modeling using industry-standard models such as GE-MAPS, PROMOD, GridView, or PLEXOS
* Basic knowledge of industry-standard power flow tools such as GE-PSLF, PSS/E, PowerWorld, CYMDIST
* Ability to demonstrate strong quantitative and/or modeling skills, specifically database management and data analysis skills
* Knowledge of linear optimization and energy and environmental markets is an advantage.
* Advanced Microsoft Office (Excel and VBA) skills
* Knowledge of Excel macro programming and other programming languages
* Good research skills
* Strong analytical and organizational skills

**About Business line/Function:**
The Cybersecurity & Digital Fraud department’s objective is to protect the Bank and its clients from Cybersecurity and Cyber Fraud risks.
  
  
This department is in charge of permanent monitoring of the evolution of Cyber Risks in the Group’s Information Systems to guarantee the security of the Bank and ensure the deployment of measures to protect customers while raising employees’ awareness of fraud risks particularly.
  
  
Its mission aims at structuring, strengthening, and harmonizing IT risks management and Cybersecurity for BNP Paribas Group and
  
  

* Defining the vision and strategy for IT risk management and Cybersecurity, and ensuring the implementation of this strategy within the Group’s operating entities,
* Monitoring the security of the Group's information systems,
* Steering the IT Continuity and Resilience strategy and methodological framework.

The evolving Cyberthreats landscape increases the risk of the financial sector, which leads BNP Paribas to strengthen its Cybersecurity maturity, IT risk management and Operation Resilience.
  
  
Whilst being mainly based in France, the Cybersecurity & Digital Fraud Department is developing globally since 2021, especially in India (Mumbai, Chennai & Bangalore) and Portugal (Lisbon & Porto).

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Business Data Analyst

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
8+ Years

**About the role:**

Latinum is looking for an experienced Business Data Analyst for a client to drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.

The role involves partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse business processes and datasets, assess solution feasibility, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. You will work closely with Data Engineering and BI teams to deliver scalable data solutions on Azure, covering the complete SDLC from requirement gathering to deployment and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders across multiple domains to gather, analyse, challenge, and document business requirements through workshops and discovery sessions.
* Perform business process analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), and gap analysis to validate business rules, identify data quality issues, and define future-state solutions.
* Assess functional and technical feasibility, implementation approaches, dependencies, risks, and solution options.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, process flows, business rules, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and project documentation.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering and BI teams.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, track implementation, resolve functional issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Write and optimise SQL queries on Azure Synapse and Salesforce staging data for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, and DAX measures for enterprise reporting and KPI tracking.
* Define and validate requirements for data integrations, reporting, automation, and data quality improvements.
* Coordinate SIT and UAT, manage defects, validate acceptance criteria, and obtain stakeholder sign-off.
* Support production deployments and post-production hypercare, coordinating issue resolution between business and technical teams.
* Maintain KPI definitions, data dictionaries, governance artefacts, and reporting standards while managing multiple initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Enterprise Reporting within large or complex organisations.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end requirements and delivery across discovery, analysis, documentation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong expertise in business process analysis, EDA, gap analysis, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Azure Synapse Analytics or equivalent MPP/cloud data warehouse platforms.
* Advanced Power BI skills, including semantic modelling, DAX, dashboard development, and enterprise reporting.
* Good understanding of relational databases, ETL/ELT concepts, data modelling, source-to-target mappings, and data governance.
* Experience translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering teams.
* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Data Engineering teams.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Strong documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and testing artefacts.
* Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate industry experience is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ideal Candidate: A strong Business Data Analyst who combines business requirements ownership, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, Azure data platform exposure, and end-to-end SDLC delivery experience.
